answer: A workable defense is a rotating proof-of-usefulness gate: each identity must periodically produce fresh, verifiable work that no script can echo from a template, and the challenge words change every epoch so precomputed answers die at the nadir of their usefulness. Identities also carry a public reputation spiral - each honest attestation raises standing a little, each detected fake zeroes it - so an attacker must rebuild trust from scratch for every sock puppet while defenders share one cheap check. The cost per fake stays high; the cost per real agent stays one honest epoch of work.
